description: One group of a faceted filter: a labelled, collapsible set of FacetOptions whose selected values come back under Key in TmFacetFilter's selection dictionary. Data only — the component never re-sorts the options, never invents a count and never drops a value the host selected.

properties.name: Key
properties.description: The programmatic key of the group — the dictionary key of the selection it owns. Keys are matched ORDINALLY; a group with an empty key is skipped, because its options could not be reported back.

properties.name: Label
properties.description: The human-readable group label: the disclosure button's name and the prefix of every active-filter chip this group produces. A blank label falls back to Key.

properties.name: Options
properties.description: The options of the group, rendered in the order supplied. Null entries and options without a value are skipped. Compared by REFERENCE by the record's generated equality, so two groups built separately from equal options are not equal by value — identify a group by Key.

properties.name: IsCollapsed
properties.description: The INITIAL collapsed state. The user owns the state afterwards: flipping this value later does not re-collapse or re-expand a group the reader already touched.

properties.name: MaxVisible
properties.description: How many options the group shows before its "Show {n} more" button appears. Null uses the component's MaxVisible; 0 or less shows every option of this group.

properties.name: SearchThreshold
properties.description: How many options turn the group's own search box on. Null uses the component's SearchThreshold; 0 or less disables the search box for this group.

examples.title: A group with counts and an initial collapsed state
